title: Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) outbreak – ongoing
detail: Ongoing since May 2026; >11,000 confirmed cases. Provinces affected include Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Sud-Ubangi and Nord-Ubangi. Complete the ACDP VHF risk assessment if onset is within 21 days of leaving.

title: Ebola – imported case linked to DRC outbreak
detail: One case reported 20 Oct 2026 (travelled via Addis Ababa). Contacts completing 21-day monitoring in Nov 2026. Lassa fever is also endemic.

title: Ebola – cluster linked to DRC outbreak (monitoring completed)
detail: Nine cases, last reported 20 Oct 2026; all contacts completed monitoring by 11 Nov 2026.

title: Ebola outbreak declared over (28 Jul 2026)
detail: Borders the active DRC outbreak area – ask about cross-border travel.
